reason: I do not know this website or the people behind it, and I would have to give them my resume and my data. Even the free part asks me to trust a new site, and I already follow one YouTuber's free playlists, so I see no reason to pay a stranger 299 rupees a month.
objection: I don't know who runs UNBLUFF or what they do with my resume and my personal details once I upload them.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, readable privacy promise plus a free version that shows me real results on my own resume and plan before I ever have to pay.
